suggested_change: Rubric should specify: (1) carry-forward vs. new-evidence scoring rules explicitly for multi-call analyses; (2) minimum evidence thresholds (direct quotes + date sourced); (3) next steps must include contact name, specific question, and target completion date; (4) stage and overall health must be justified against scoring, not contradicted; (5) pain scoring requires pain articulation in the reviewed call, not prior state only.
